proposals.before: In the winter of Tianfu year seven, An Congjin of Xiangyang rebelled and led troops against Nanyang; Jianchong then commanded more than a thousand foot and horse at Ye County; the Prince of Zheng, as Kaifeng intendant, sent Palace Commissioner Zhang Congen and Imperial City Commissioner Jiao Jixun with the capital armies to join Jianchong; at Huashan in Huyang they met Congjin's force, Jianchong gave battle and routed them, and for his merit was made regimental commissioner of Bo.
proposals.after: In the winter of Tianfu year seven, An Congjin of Xiangzhou rebelled and led troops against Nanyang; Jianchong then commanded more than a thousand foot and horse at Ye County; the Prince of Zheng, as Kaifeng intendant, sent Palace Commissioner Zhang Congen and Imperial City Commissioner Jiao Jixun with the capital armies to join Jianchong; at Huashan in Huyang they met Congjin's force, Jianchong gave battle and routed them, and for his merit was made regimental commissioner of Bo.
proposals.reason: The Chinese names 襄州安從進, not 襄陽; Xiangyang appears only later when the city is pacified.

decisions.reason: 累贈太子太師 records repeated posthumous honors of an office, not a fief. 'Enfeoffed' is the wrong verb; 'honored' matches 贈.
長直都校 names the Long-Duty Guard command, not a place Changzhi. The replacement matches the office and the chapter's idiomatic wording.
贈中書令 is a posthumous grant of the Secretariat directorship, not an enfeoffment.
The literal likewise renders 贈 as enfeoffment. 'Granted the title' is the correct action for this posthumous office.
詔贈太子少師 is an edict conferring a posthumous office, not a fief. 'Granted him the office' corrects 贈.
The same 詔贈 is mistranslated as enfeoffment in the literal. The office Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent is kept.
加檢校司徒 is acting Situ. Minister of Works would be 司空, a different office.
The literal makes the same 司徒/司空 error. 'Acting title of Situ' restores the office named in the Chinese.
制贈中書令 is a posthumous office by edict, not an enfeoffment.
The literal repeats the 贈/enfeoffment error for the same 中書令.
授檢校司徒 is acting Situ, not Minister of Works (司空).

sourceWitness.excerpt: 授檢校司徒、大內皇城使

decisions.reason: The literal likewise misrenders 檢校司徒 as Minister of Works.
優詔贈中書令 is a gracious edict conferring a posthumous office, not a fief.
The literal has the same 贈/enfeoffment error for 中書令.
陳州宛丘 is Wanqiu, the Chen prefectural seat. Wancheng is a different place-name.
The literal likewise misreads 宛丘 as Wancheng. Wanqiu is the correct transcription.
The Chinese names 襄州安從進. Xiangyang appears only later at 襄陽平, so the rebel's base here is Xiangzhou.
遷深州刺史 is Shenzhou (深州), not the 申州 already rendered Shen in s0108. The gloss prevents collapsing two prefectures.
檢校司徒 is acting Situ (Minister over the Masses), not Sikong, Minister of Works.
The literal makes the same 司徒/司空 substitution. The replacement restores Situ.
鄆州 is Yun Prefecture. Yan would be 兗州 or 燕; the original uses the wrong homophone.
The literal likewise renders 鄆州 as Yan. Yun Prefecture is the correct name.
左屯衛將軍 is a general (將軍), not a colonel. The following 大將軍 in s0142 is a higher grade of the same word.
The literal repeats colonel for 將軍. General is the accurate rank term.
歸汶上 is a return to Wenshang, not a place named Wen.
汶上 is Wenshang, and 而卒 is sequential ('and died'), not purpose ('to die').
丁父憂 is entering mourning; 起復 is recall while still in mourning, not after mourning ended.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 丁父憂，起復授右千牛衛大將軍

decisions.reason: The literal likewise turns 起復 into the end of mourning. Recall during mourning is the sense of 起復.
唐景思 is Tang Jingsi. Jing Jingsi invents a surname from 唐 and is not in the Chinese.
The literal repeats the false surname Jing for 唐景思. Tang Jingsi is the name given.
命為濠州行州刺史 names acting prefect of Hao Prefecture. 'On the Hao campaign' is not in the office title; 濠梁未下 only explains why the post is acting.
The literal likewise recasts 濠州行州刺史 as a campaign title instead of the prefecture named.
授若驍衛大將軍 appoints him Grand General of the Xiao Guard; 若 is the appointment particle, not part of a unit name Ruoxiao.
The literal treats 若 as part of Ruoxiao. The office is 驍衛大將軍.
The sentence completed by 之父也 makes Zhang Ying Yongde's father. 駙馬都尉 is Yongde's title, not Zhang Ying's relation as son-in-law.
The completed Chinese 駙馬都尉永德之父也 identifies Zhang Ying as Yongde's father, not as Yongde's son-in-law.
The Chinese of s0221 has no personal name. 'He' correctly continues Zhang Ying's biography after 之父也; replacing it with Ying is optional disambiguation, not a source error.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 累為藩郡列校，由內職歷諸衛將軍。

decisions.reason: 偽右監門衛將軍 marks the Wu office as illegitimate in the Zhou historian's voice, not 檢校 'acting', and the rank is 將軍, not Grand General.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 累遷為偽右監門衛將軍

decisions.reason: The literal likewise reads 偽 as acting and inflates 將軍 to Grand General. 'Illegitimate office of General' restores both points.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0029 restores 唐景思 as Tang Jingsi; the English name Jing Jingsi was created only by the mistranslation.
